prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion", "Your pet is ready to join your desktop environment.", "Pet Control Sandbox", "Try moving, calling, or hiding your pet before jumping back to work.", "Press Alt+Pet to summon or right-click pet for main menu", "Launch to Desktop"]
1: ["Sign In & Restore Your Pets", "Connect your account to save pet progress and bring existing desktop companions back.", "Cloud Pet Sync Enabled: Restores existing companions automatically", "Continue with Account"]
2: ["Choose Your Companion's Personality", "Listen to voice clips and pick a personality style for your desktop pet.", "Playful, Calm, or Energetic personality traits", "Preview companion bark and meow sounds"]
3: ["Almost Ready for Launch", "Desktop Display & Tray Setup", "Your pet lives on your desktop overlay. Look for the tray icon if minimized.", "Using multiple monitors? Drag your companion between displays seamlessly.", "Complete Onboarding"]
4: ["Upload Custom Companion Photos", "Ensure clear lighting and a single pet subject for optimal AI companion generation."]
5: ["Discover Desktop Companions", "Scroll through pet capabilities, desktop interaction modes, and custom habits.", "Virtual companions that live right on your desktop wallpaper", "Choose My Path"]
6: ["Preparing Desktop Environment", "Checking screen resolution, overlay support, and background rendering compatibility.", "Display Overlay Permission Verified", "Building Pet Animations..."]
7: ["Sign In to Protect Your Pet", "Signing in locks your pet's appearance, names, and unlocked traits safely to cloud storage."]
8: ["Your Companion is Ready to Play!", "Here are the top 3 ways to interact with your pet on your desktop.", "Your new pet is idling on your desktop", "Right-Click: Context Menu | Drag: Move Pet | Double-Click: Play", "Start Playing"]
9: ["How Would You Like to Start?", "Instant Pet takes under 30 seconds; Custom Creation lets you build from photos."]
